note: BH-9936 (BH-9926 wave 4): settings row lane.merge-conductor.gh_source. Where the conductor's ci-read step (mc_ci_state with the PR number) reads a PR head's CI word: off = GitHub only (actions/runs, today's read); shadow (default) = the PR record (prr_ci_state) and GitHub, the conductor acts on GitHub and logs one PRR_SHADOW line in logs/prr-shadow.log when the words differ; record = the PR record only for green and pending, 0 actions/runs reads, and red, unknown or a record miss reads GitHub and logs PRR_MISS. Any other value is shadow plus one PRR_STEP line. Read by prr_step in bin/lib/prr-shadow.sh.
